anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all intervals (1, 5, and 15 minutes), indicating potential overutilization or bottleneck.
AI system has not generated any learning cycles, opportunities, or adjustments, suggesting it may not be functioning correctly.
Trading system shows no active trades or profit/loss activity, which is unusual for a trading platform.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU-intensive processes to reduce load and improve system responsiveness.
Review and potentially restart AI components to ensure they are actively learning and generating opportunities.
Evaluate trading strategies and system configurations to ensure trades are being executed as expected.

recommendations.action: Investigate the cause of high CPU load and address any underlying issues such as inefficient processes or resource leaks.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system instability and degraded performance, impacting trading operations and user experience.

recommendations.action: Restart the AI system and monitor its performance to ensure it resumes normal operation.
recommendations.rationale: The AI system is not functioning, which could lead to missed trading opportunities and reduced platform effectiveness.

recommendations.action: Conduct a thorough review of trading system logs and configurations to identify why no trades are active or generating profit/loss.
recommendations.rationale: A non-functional trading system directly impacts revenue and user satisfaction, requiring immediate attention.
